g.text: One write, three cache layers to reconcile -- versioned keys first, active purge as fallback
Preferred path (no purge call needed): versioned cache keys.
product:123:v7 -> product:123:v8 is a NEW key on every layer at once -- automatic
cache MISS everywhere the instant the version bumps. Old v7 entries just age out on TTL.
Active purge (right side of this diagram) is the fallback ONLY for keys that can't be versioned
(e.g. "this user's session") -- and it's rate-limited, so it's reserved, not the default.
